notes.title: 桃色武林 On sale
notes.content:
From project establishment to production of trial version, to re-production of official version, and then to online, Peach Color Wulin (Dual Cultivation Wulin) has spent two years, and finally officially meets everyone.

This work is an independent short game made by one person
The game is based on Unity
The character drawing and CG are generated by AI, and then edited by the artist. I would like to thank Chaoda and Qingda for their help. Without you, the art effect of this work would not be so good.
The plot of the game is in the direction of new martial arts. We borrowed the content of (Demon Sword Record), and Yanda wrote nearly 100,000 words of the plot.
The gameplay is the survivor-like type that I personally like very much. The organization of the gameplay is more focused on refreshing construction rather than the kind that requires thinking.
The concept of survival is borrowed from (Lance 10). Originally, it was hoped to design a multi-round survival design similar to Lan 10, but after it was launched overseas, it received a lot of criticism from players, so it was changed to the current appearance, so that everyone can experience it easily.

This is the second game I made personally. The previous one was the much-criticized Dragon Aotian's Multiverse. People said that my script was written by AI... But, in fact, I wrote it myself.

I hope that through this new work, everyone can understand my dedication and difficulties as an independent developer. I also thank my group friends who have always supported me, and the few crowdfunding friends. Thank you very much!

Now the game begins!
